com.sun.tools.sjavac.server

类 CompilerPool

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.tools.sjavac.server.CompilerPool

  • public class CompilerPool
extends Object
    The compiler pool maintains compiler threads.

    This is NOT part of any supported API. If you write code that depends on this, you do so at your own risk. This code and its internal interfaces are subject to change or deletion without notice.

      Execute a compiler thread.

      Execute a minor task, for example generating bytecodes and writing them to disk, that belong to a major compiler thread task.
